tool_input.command:
hops sql --no-verify --schema mlpabc85bc9_featurestore "
SELECT t.row_id, t.account_id, t.event_time,
  t.amount * f.fx_rate AS amount_usd,
  CASE WHEN day_of_week(from_unixtime(t.event_time/1000)) IN (6,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_weekend,
  SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.event_time RANGE BETWEEN 604800000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_7d
FROM transactions_1 t
JOIN fx_rates_1 f ON t.currency = f.currency
ORDER BY t.row_id
LIMIT 5" 2>&1 | grep -v -E "INFO:|UserWarning|pip install|compatibility|Closing|Connection closed|Logged in|Initializing|Base URL|Python Engine" | tail -20

hops sql --no-verify --catalog hive --schema mlpabc85bc9_featurestore "
SELECT t.row_id, t.account_id, t.event_time,
  t.amount * f.fx_rate AS amount_usd,

ORDER BY t.row_id
LIMIT 5" 2>&1 | grep -v -E "INFO:|UserWarning|pip install|compatibility|Closing|Connection closed|Logged in|Initializing|Base URL|Python Engine" | tail -20

mkdir -p .tmp && hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabc85bc9_featurestore --limit 0 --json "
